column1: # distribution-manifest.tsv — hard companion dependencies that a path scan cannot see
# `verify-distribution.sh` already derives dependencies from full-path references
# This file only carries the ones that reference is *not* written as a scannable
# repo-relative path — bare root-level filenames, mostly — and would otherwise be
# Add an entry when a skill stops working (or, worse, keeps working while
# silently dropping a dimension) because a file the diff-based distribution
# never carried is absent downstream. Do not add entries a path scan already
# covers: a duplicated dependency is a second place to forget to update.

column3: /review Step 3-2 reads it and applies §1 as its own dimension; without it min() silently loses the PJ-norm dimension and returns a passing verdict from an incomplete review
